name: Lincoln Park Summer Camp
street_address: Lincoln Park Middle School, 92 Ryerson Road
description_short: Borough morning day camp for Lincoln Park children entering kindergarten through grade 6: two days a week at Lincoln Park Middle School, two lake days at the LP Beach Club and one trip day, with games, crafts and theme weeks. Only Lincoln Park residents can register.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds for missed days, weeks or trips; refunds only if the borough cancels camp. Week transfers allowed with notice.
swim_waterfront_notes: Lake days Tuesdays and Thursdays at the LP Beach Club with lifeguards; every camper is swim tested and needs a signed swim permission form.
notes: Lincoln Park residents only. Monday to Friday 8:30 am to 12:30 pm; no before or after care. $140 per week if paid by May 3, $180 per week after that and for add-on weeks (week 2, with no camp July 3: $115 early or $140). Trip fees are included. Non-emergency late pick ups cost $5 per half hour.
